proposals.before: When Emperor Ming acceded, Ji became grand commandant attendant; he followed Prince of Jian'an Xiuren against Zhuchi, was transferred to Ji as army marshal, named gentleman at the Yellow Gate, then sent out as general who proclaims might and governor of Dongyang, and made director of the ministry of personnel.
